name: Recover Account Access
summary: Restores access to an existing durable identity through an enumeration-resistant request, challenge issuance, proof verification, replacement credential establishment, and recovery completion.

completionPredicate.expression: recovery-state == completed and replacement-credential-established == true and prior sessions are revoked

coverageAssessment.rationale: The successful recovery activity is fully decomposed into atomic scenarios, but rejected proof and challenge outcomes are not yet represented as separate scenarios.
